versions.content: Support of session layer service Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support the session layer services defined by ISO-14229-2. Rationale: OSI compliant network adaption. Use Case: Organizing the diagnostic communication within heterogeneous network systems (e.g.keep alive logic). AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
